schema.output_rule: Array<I64> of the same shape and nullable-element policy as specified by the operation.
schema.empty_frame_rule: Either zero spatial extent produces an empty output with zero neighbourhood-kernel invocations.

cardinality.rule: Exactly height*width logical output elements; checked product.

requirements: One-cell halo on both spatial axes.
Chunk boundaries are not image boundaries.
No alias permits partially updated input reads.

read_access.halo_rule: Eight row-major offsets from a centred 3x3 footprint, excluding the centre; Fill(0) at the image boundary.

validity.null_rule: Any invalid neighbour makes the output invalid.
validity.inactive_rule: No activity mask in this example.

effects.failure_rule: Checked right-associated I64 addition; report overflow at the responsible output coordinate.

numeric.equivalence_requirement: Same result/validity or same failure category as the scalar reference evaluator for each cell.

resources.scratch_bound: Declared tile plus halo; planner charges scratch before kernel admission.
resources.output_bound: height*width*sizeof(i64) plus validity representation, all checked.

assumptions: Rust/allocator and checked indexing behave according to their contracts.

outcomes.success_relation: Every valid output equals the exact right sum of the eight ordered neighbours.
outcomes.success_conditions: Valid shape/storage, sufficient declared output and tile scratch, no active-cell arithmetic overflow and no requested cancellation.
outcomes.error_relation: Report the specified shape/resource/overflow or cancellation outcome; no numerical failure becomes a null silently.
outcomes.mutation_frame: The source remains unchanged; the selected atomic output API commits only after successful completion.
outcomes.termination: Finite tile and footprint traversal; cancellation checks occur at declared tile boundaries.

proof_contract.logical_model: Numeric collection shape, bit-valued cells and validity; coordinate stencil relation.
proof_contract.callable_binding: Required executable/specification binding before implementation acceptance; none exists yet.
proof_contract.evidence_record: proof-evidence.schema.json defines the required evidence format; all obligations here are planned.
proof_contract.trust_status: Unverified design example, not a verified or tested kernel.

cost_contract.model: Tracked output payload and validity plus bounded tile/halo scratch; worst-case neighbourhood work.
cost_contract.classification: Symbolic conservative bound under the declared allocation model, not elapsed-time prediction.
cost_contract.assumptions: Actual allocation capacities, target layout, and concurrency must match the admitted schedule.
cost_contract.control_scope: Only allocations made through the declared execution context; no whole-process RSS or arbitrary callback guarantee.
